title: The Cipher of Kowloon
author: Astrid Ashgrove
blurb: August Brightwater, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
